title: Buddy Petit compared with Chris Kelly
summary: Petit was faster on the valves while Kelly had a stronger tone; they played the same numbers such as Panama Rag and Tailgate Ramblers.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles

How did Buddy sound compared to, say, Chris Kelly? Did they, anything in life, or different?
